title: Compliance pocket todo - daily scratchpad
content:
Compliance pocket scratchpad - quick log

2026-03-12 AM sprint
- Wake up note: focus on evidence intake for CC01 & CC02 (access controls)
- Quick wins: finish Okta vendor attestation check, upload artifact for user-provisioning flow

TODAY'S MUSTS (top 5)
1) Finish evidence packet: user-provisioning-runbook.pdf + screenshots (Okta admin -> provisioning policy) - target: 14:00
2) Triage Datadog logs export for incident-demo (link to bucket) -> number of incidents to sample = 10
3) Start vendor review doc for new SSO supplier (AuthForge) - checklist below
4) Policy TODO: update 'Temporary access' flow with step for KMS key approval
5) Quick sync w/ Marcus 11:30 (15m) - blockers on evidence ingestion automation

EVIDENCE CHECKLIST (working)
- CC01: account lifecycle
  - [ ] onboarding checklist (HR -> IdP provisioning) - need HR request template (ask People Ops)
  - [x] offboarding steps documented (offboard-checklist-v2.md)
  - [ ] sample audit log export (Datadog -> S3) - in progress, exporting 7 days
- CC02: system access
  - [ ] MFA enforcement proof (Okta policy screenshot) - capture 2 device types
  - [x] least-privilege role map (roles-matrix.xlsx uploaded)
- CC03: encryption & keys
  - [ ] KMS key rotation policy (draft) - TODO: review with infra
  - [ ] evidence of key policy being applied to backups (ask infra for report)

VENDOR REVIEW - AuthForge (first pass notes)
- Business case: cheaper SSO price tier, better SCIM support
- Info to gather: SOC2 report, pen test summary, encryption at rest details, shared responsibility matrix
- Quick risk flags: new company (founded 2024), no public SOC2 link on homepage, support SLAs unclear
- Action items:
  - [ ] Request SOC2 report and pen test dates (email vendor template saved in /templates/vendor-ask.txt)
  - [ ] Check for data residency options (APAC)
  - [ ] Add to vendor-triage board (JIRA-VEND-102)

POLICY TODOS (short)
- Temp access: insert KMS approval step + 24h auto-revoke for ephemeral keys
- Third-party data flows: map where vendor-access touches PII (start w/ SSO and monitoring agents)
- Evidence retention: confirm retention window for logs used in audits (ask Legal)

MEETING NOTES (11:30 w/ Marcus)
- Marcus: ingestion pipeline blocked by API rate limits from Okta side (we should batch and backfill)
- Agreement: add a retry/backoff and low-priority queue for historic imports; fast path for daily deltas
- Follow-ups: Marcus to open infra issue with rate-limit thresholds; I will draft design for batch job and add to PRD

BLOCKERS
- Need People Ops template for onboarding to prove HR-triggered provisioning (ask Priya)
- Okta API rate limit preventing full export (workaround: incremental + snapshot)

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep evidence filenames consistent: prefix with CCID (e.g., CC01_okta_provisioning_20260312.png)
- When uploading, add metadata: evidence_type, date_range, owner
- If vendor rejects SOC2 request, escalate to Legal + procurement (email template exists)

QUICK LINKS & COMMANDS
- Confluence evidence hub: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/SOC2+evidence+index
- Okta export (admin): /admin/org/export -> use --range=7d
- Datadog logs -> s3 export job name pattern: dd-export-soc2-YYYYMMDD
- JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-SEC-789

END OF SCRATCHPAD - save as later version before upload

(Informal: drafty, incomplete, shorthand. Will clean up before sharing with audit team. This file is my quick brain-dump for the day.)
